          Experience the Timeless Hospitality and Ancient Wonders of Jordan with Saudia Airlines

          Journey to a land where ancient history meets breathtaking natural beauty. From the rose-red facades of Petra to the serene shores of the Dead Sea, Jordan invites you to explore its legendary landscapes and experience the legendary warmth of its people. Let Saudia carry you to the heart of the Levant for an adventure that bridges the past and the present.


          1. Float Effortlessly In The Dead Sea

          Rejuvenate your body at the lowest point on earth. The mineral-rich waters allow you to buoyant easily, providing a natural spa experience under the warm sun.


          2. Explore The Ancient Wonders Of Petra

          Walk through the narrow Siq to reveal the stunning Treasury carved into pink sandstone. This archaeological marvel showcases the ingenuity of the Nabataean civilization.


          3. Camp Under Stars In Wadi Rum

          Discover the majestic Valley of the Moon. Spend a night in a traditional camp surrounded by towering rock formations and a brilliant canopy of desert stars.


          4. Savor National Flavors With Mansaf

          Indulge in Jordan’s signature dish. This hearty meal of tender lamb cooked in fermented yogurt and served over rice represents the pinnacle of local culinary pride.


          5. Hike The Scenic Jordan Trail

          Challenge yourself on a trek through diverse landscapes. Traverse rugged mountains and fertile valleys to see the country from a truly unique perspective.


          6. Immerse In Bedouin Hospitality

          Connect with local traditions over a cup of sage-infused tea. The genuine kindness and storytelling of the Bedouin people offer a deep look into Jordan’s soul.


          7. Taste Authentic Local Street Food

          Bite into hot falafel and fresh hummus in the bustling streets of Amman. Every corner offers a chance to sample the vibrant, zesty flavors of the city.


          8. Discover The Dana Biosphere Reserve

          Wander through Jordan’s largest nature reserve. It is a haven for hikers and nature lovers, featuring dramatic cliffs and a wide variety of rare wildlife.


          9. Master Traditional Jordanian Cooking

          Join a local kitchen to learn the secrets of Levantine spices. Preparing your own feast is the perfect way to bring the taste of Jordan home with you.


          10. Wander Through Historic Desert Castles

          Trace the steps of ancient travelers. These well-preserved desert fortresses tell stories of early Islamic art and serve as beautiful landmarks of a bygone era.

          Cities You Should Visit When Traveling to Jordan

          1. Amman

          Experience the heartbeat of a kingdom where ancient ruins meet a pulsing modern soul. Scale the Citadel for a panoramic view of the capital's seven hills, then dive into the bustling downtown souks to savor the world's finest falafel. Wander through the artistic alleys of Rainbow Street and discover a city that celebrates its history while racing toward a bright future. Experience authentic Jordanian hospitality in every cafe and gallery of this hill-crowned metropolis.
